findings.title: Unbounded XP farming via repeatable quest completion
findings.reproduce: assign→complete→assign→complete the same ACTIVE template repeatedly awarded XP per instance (new questId each time)
findings.root_cause: idempotency was per quest instance (questId), not per (user, template); no guard against re-assigning an already-completed template
findings.fix: template-scoped idempotencyKey quest_complete_${userId}_${questTemplateId}; /assign returns 409 on COMPLETED template

findings.title: No rate limiting on quest/task completion endpoints
findings.reproduce: completion endpoints were unthrottled; a malicious client could flood mutations
findings.fix: makeMutationLimiter() mounted on assign/progress/abandon/complete + daily-task complete, keyed by authenticated user

findings.title: Concurrent awardXp race surfaced 500 (unique-constraint violation)
findings.reproduce: two concurrent awards with same idempotencyKey both passed inner re-check, second INSERT hit unique constraint → 500
findings.root_cause: READ COMMITTED allows both transactions to pass the SELECT re-check before either commits
findings.fix: catch 23505 on xp_transactions_idempotency_key_unique and return alreadyAwarded

findings.title: 532 weakness_vs_reason contradictions (weak-area recommendation without WEAK_AREA reason code)
findings.reproduce: recommendTasks surfaced ENDURANCE weak area but reasonCodes lacked WEAK_AREA
findings.root_cause: WEAK_AREA driven only by single scoring factor, not the multi-area detectWeaknesses set
findings.fix: emit WEAK_AREA for weakness>=0.7 OR weakAreas membership; compute weakAreas from detectWeaknesses in both recommendation paths

findings.title: Malformed/negative/NaN/huge XP and attribute deltas accepted into progression
findings.reproduce: awardXp with negative/NaN/huge values could pollute user_attributes and xp_transactions
findings.fix: sanitize: drop negative/NaN/non-finite; clamp oversized; PATCH progress path awards no XP
